description.value: Cinnzeo is a Canadian franchise bakery café best known for freshly baked cinnamon rolls in classic and specialty flavours, all topped with cream cheese frosting and prepared throughout the day. The menu also includes savoury options like Cheesy Garlic Dippers, Lavazza espresso and coffee drinks, smoothies, and frappes — a reasonable pit stop for a quick energy boost. The North Vancouver location sits on the first floor of a shopping mall.
